# DAB Hands

> I help digital-forward businesses get their best work into the world, intact. Senior operational leadership for important work moving through complex organisations.

DAB Hands is the digital home of Darren Brett, a senior digital operator with the heart of a creative. Not a consultancy, not an agency, not a transformation practice. I am brought in when important work needs to keep moving through complexity, from focused operational leadership to longer-running support. Backed by more than 20 years helping global brands move important digital work from idea to market without losing momentum, quality, or intent.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dabhands.delivery/): The proposition and point of view. The tools are changing, the problems aren't. Most organisations already have what they need; the challenge is helping it move together so it arrives as intended.
- [Business & agency leaders](https://dabhands.delivery/business-and-agency-leaders): For leaders who need stronger movement across teams, partners, priorities, and initiatives. Experienced operational leadership that understands delivery, commercial realities, people, and how organisations actually work.
- [Marketing leaders](https://dabhands.delivery/marketing-leaders): For marketing leaders who need confidence that important work reaches customers without losing momentum, quality, or intent. Campaigns, launches, experiences, and agencies moving together.
- [Creators & founders](https://dabhands.delivery/creators-and-founders): For creators and founders who need operational strength without unnecessary bureaucracy or loss of identity. Keeping the energy, creativity, and ambition that made the business successful.
- [Contact](https://dabhands.delivery/contact): Reach out directly for important work that needs to move properly.
